column1: # The viewer's controls: what each does, its icon, and the row of
# `data/text.tsv` that names it, which is shown under the pointer.
# `zoom`, `share`, `save`, `open`, `undo` and `redo` are the tools at its
# top right,
# from the left in the order of their rows here; a row taken out is a
# tool not drawn. A row whose name ends in `.on` is the same tool once
# it is on: the picture larger, the path copied.
# `zoom` shows the picture larger and whole again. `share` copies where
# the picture's file is to the system's clipboard. `save` asks, in the
# system's own dialog, where a copy is to be kept. `open` opens the
# file in the system's own program for pictures.
zoom
zoom.on
share
share.on
save
open
# The way out, beside the tools; the picture before and the one after.
close
before
after
# Marks on the picture, as Google Photos has them: the last one taken
# back and put back again, at the top right after the tools; the marks
# kept with the picture, the pill at the end (`keep`, its words beside
# its icon); and under the picture what a press on it does, a line
# sketched or words set, each with its words under it.
undo
redo
keep
keep.on
sketch
text
